svg.text: BricoHams | Componentes
multimode-028
PICTOGRAMA NO A ESCALA
Power distribution harness Anderson Powerpole-family
input and DC fuses
Referencia: MMA-028
Cantidad de la fila: 1 set
Exact Powerpole model/housing orientation/contacts,
mating polarity, crimp tool, conductor gauge/length and
all DC fuse/holder ratings remain TBD; validate actual
assemblies with DMM, never color/family appearance alone.
Include source-positive master fuse close to battery and
independent branch fuse locations for CM5 5 V converter,
motor power/NC E-stop cutoff path, and RF PA. Candidate
upstream EMI treatment after master fuse: common-mode
choke in both DC conductors, appropriately coordinated
TVS and reverse-polarity protection; optional damped
branch LC plus local decoupling DNP pending converter
stability/vendor criteria and bench evidence. Specify
choke/inductor low DCR, continuous/inrush current,
saturation, thermal and impedance performance; TVS
stand-off/clamp/energy and reverse-protection ratings;
branch-fuse normal/inrush/current and DC
voltage/interrupt/time-current curve against prospective
fault current. All values, part models,
wire/contact/holder ampacity and lengths remain TBD;
external battery BMS is not a fuse.
TBD
PROTOTIPO / NO FABRICAR NI CABLEAR DESDE ESTA FICHA
Anatol EA5KAO · Diego EA5JEF · Pedro Roca Molina | bricohams.org
